diagram.title: Shadow, canary and A/B testing
diagram.caption: Error rate can be a canary guardrail. Conversion rate can be the A/B test outcome.

columns.heading: Shadow
items: Copy live requests to the new model

columns.heading: Canary
items: Route 5% of live requests to the new model
Roll back if a guardrail breaks

columns.heading: A/B test
items: Randomly assign users to stable groups
Assigned model decides for each user
